package main

// Excerpt of openweft/weft-block v0.2.0 (cmd/weft-block/driver.go:860-862):
// the env name is read from another variable, and the literal is only the
// fallback. os.Getenv never sees a literal.

import "os"

func passphrase() string {
	envName := os.Getenv("WEFT_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE_ENV")
	if envName == "" {
		envName = "WEFT_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE"
	}
	return os.Getenv(envName)
}

func main() { _ = passphrase() }
